Unfortunately, no. Free Standard shipping applies to orders of **$75 or more after discounts (and before tax)**. With your promo code, your total is $70, which is $5 under the threshold, so Standard shipping would be **$7.95**.

- **Reaching the threshold:** if you add items so your order is $75 or more *after* the promo discount, Standard shipping becomes free.
- **Leafy Plus:** membership is $59/year and includes free Standard shipping with no minimum. Express ($14.95) is never free, even for members.

Promo codes can't be added after an order is placed, so check your total at checkout before you confirm.
